name: Patient Tithe
description: Take a patient tithe from every blow in a long fight and add it to a store that never fills.

name: Unseen Sponge
description: Soak a heavy soul blow into the soul so quietly that the striker feels no resistance.

name: Clearing Draught
description: Draw every curse and every mark of erosion from an ally and convert them all to plain force.

name: Reckoned Return
description: Return exactly the force that was drawn as a lance through the guard of the soul that sent it.

name: Deep Absorption
description: Draw an attack down to the bottom of the tithe and absorb all it carries.

name: Hollowed Will
description: Draw a target's will down to a husk so that it can no longer bear its own techniques.

name: Tithing Tide
description: Send the tide of gathered tithes out in a wave that bears down on every soul near.

name: Flawless Rebound
description: Rebound a soul strike with every part of its force drawn into the return.

name: Final Levy
description: Levy a last great tithe from every hostile force in range and fold it into the reserve.

name: Quiet Ruin
description: Drain the force from all souls in range so softly that none feels the loss until it is done.

name: Boundless Hunger
description: Open an unlimited hunger of soul force that absorbs every hostile force coming at the user.

name: Gorging Calamity
description: Loose the entire gorged store at the destructive ceiling of its tier upon every soul in range.

name: Tithe Unspent
description: Draw the force of a blow its maker has not yet struck so that the maker is left nothing to strike with.
